_comment: USDG-vault mesh manifest (testnets) — selected automatically when the chainid is a testnet. Mock mintable TestUSD underlying (no real USDG on testnets). Mirrors the mainnet launch posture: robinhood_testnet active, sepolia + arbitrum_sepolia dormant to rehearse the deposit gate + ActivateVault. robinhood_testnet CCIP lanes reach Ethereum Sepolia + Base Sepolia only. Testnet salt tags are BUMPABLE (T1 -> T2 -> ...) because CREATE3 cannot redeploy at a used address on the same chain: a fresh mesh iteration bumps the tag, clears canonical, re-runs PredictCanonicalAddress and redeploys.
